### Flat Orchestrator Pattern

    yield from _star_tian_yi(day_stem, day_branch, year_branch, check_targets)

### Guard Clause Pattern
Each star helper uses early returns:
```python
def _star_tian_yi(day_stem, day_branch, year_branch, check_targets) -> Generator[StarResult]:
    if day_branch != "Yin":
        return
    if "TianYi" not in check_targets:
        return
    yield StarResult(name="TianYi", ...)    
```

### Tuple-of-Tuples Dispatch
Replace dict lookups for star definitions with tuple constants:
```python
_STAR_DEFS: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
    ("Yin", "TianYi"),
    ...
)
```

3. Preserve all existing Pydantic return types
